title: RDC — remote desktop for people and AI agents
description: A tiny open-source remote desktop written in Zig. Open a link in any browser to see and control your Mac, PC or Linux machine from anywhere. Nothing to install on the phone. An MCP server lets AI agents work on the computer.
seo_features: Remote desktop in the browser;Connection from anywhere over WebRTC;MCP server for AI agents;Phone as the computer's microphone and camera;Permanent access with authenticator codes;Signed automatic updates
sub: A tiny remote desktop for you and your AI agents. Open a link in any browser — nothing to install on the phone.
join_ph: Paste a link from RDC to connect
join_bad: That is not an RDC link. Copy “From anywhere” in the RDC window.
num_phone: apps to install on the phone
f_any_p: One link works from mobile data or another network. Directly over WebRTC, through a relay when there is no direct path.
f_browser_p: Phone, tablet, another computer. Touchpad gestures and a full on-screen keyboard with the computer's own shortcuts.
f_ai_p: An MCP server: Claude, Codex or ChatGPT sees the screen and works with mouse and keyboard. You can stop it at any moment.
f_mic_p: Lend the phone's microphone or camera to the computer. Any app there sees an ordinary device.
f_perm_p: A link of your own that never changes, protected by codes from your authenticator app.
f_safe_p: The key lives in the link. Brokers and the relay pass only noise. Updates are signed.
how_1_p: It shows a code and two links. No account.
how_2_p: On the phone, or paste it on this page. On the same network, the code is enough.
how_3_p: The screen, the mouse and the keyboard are yours. Esc ends the session.
ag_sub: Give the agent a link from the RDC window. It works from screenshots, and the person at the computer sees it and has a Stop button.
ag_desktop: Download the bundle and open it: Claude Desktop installs it.
ag_any: The first is for any MCP client on stdio. The second gives a public URL for claude.ai or ChatGPT.
dl_sub: One small file per system. It keeps itself up to date with signed updates.
dl_mac_note: Screen, mouse and keyboard, the phone as a microphone, permanent access.
dl_win_note: Screen, mouse and keyboard. On Windows 11, the phone as a camera.
dl_linux_note: A single binary for X11 sessions.
dl_phone_note: Nothing to install. Open the link from the RDC window in the browser.
dl_first_mac: macOS: unzip, move RDC to Applications and open it. If macOS refuses, allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Then give RDC Screen Recording and Accessibility.
dl_first_win: Windows: run RDC.exe. If SmartScreen appears, choose More info → Run anyway. RDC asks for administrator rights to control every app.
dl_first_linux: Linux: chmod +x rdc-linux-x86_64 and run it in an X11 session.
